title: v1_87 / Editor
content: ## Editor ### Editor Sticky Scroll This iteration we're enabling Sticky Scroll in the editor by default. You can change this using the setting editor.stickyScroll.enabled. We have also increased the maximum number of lines that can be displayed within the editor sticky widget from 10 to 20. You can configure the maximum line count with the setting editor.stickyScroll.maxLineCount. ### Inline completions for multiple cursors This iteration we have added support for multi-cursor inline completions. Now, the inline completions are previewed and applied at both the primary and the secondary cursor positions. ### Refactor preview in multi diff editor With Refactor preview, you can review the changes that will be applied by a code refactoring. Refactor preview changes are now shown in a multi diff editor, which facilitates seeing all changes at a glance and comparing them against the previous version.
